svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Machine from a 240 x 88 x 80 mm block of 6061; finish 240 x 88 x 74 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pocket from the top: 4 mm floor, side and rear walls; 10 mm front wall.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Leave a rim 12 mm wide and 10 mm deep inside the top all round,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: drive pads 6 mm thick on the side walls at the rear (gearbox faces),

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: idler bosses 16 mm across, 8 mm proud, and four floor pads 10 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: across and 8 mm tall for the tray. Hole positions: hull-holes picture.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Rim top: O-ring groove 2.4 wide x 1.3 deep, 8.3 mm in from the outside;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: ten M4 tapped holes 8 deep, 5 mm in from the outside edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Side walls: 8.2 mm shaft bore and 16 mm seal counterbore 6 deep from

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: outside; two 4.5 mm gearbox screw holes; M6 idler hole 10 deep.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Front wall: 50 mm camera bore; O-ring groove 56 to 61 mm across,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 1.3 deep; four M4 bezel holes 7 deep; 5 mm lead hole; M3 camera holes.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Rear wall: 10.2 mm penetrator hole on the centre line, 55 mm up from the bottom.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: leak test at 20 kPa with the lid, plug and blanks fitted.
